payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-22, first-hand in vc's session, read at 06:55Z by vc's date -u; hv's words: "Yes, agreed. I want all of these fixed as a matter of urgency and then released.") ST0095's close-time Highlander sweep (refs/bank/vc/st0095/highlander-close-*, close-E-start-vs-close): the eight behavioural defects it found are fixed now and released, ahead of other work. They are the acceptance-gate scanner reading ST plus four digits only; todo.md and acceptance.md ordering hashed ids as text; is_ac_id refusing hashed-package labels; remint leaving Descoped.to and inherited_from on the old id; ac new and at new taking any label; the CLI's issue door skipping the address check; and three manual parity tools assuming ST0001. The rest of the duplication residue is descoped to a follow-up thread. The release follows the fixes; the cut stays hv's to confirm.
